categories.why_model_struggles: Crowded scenes with overlapping instances make instance boundaries hard to separate. The model may detect some objects but mask shapes overlap poorly with ground truth, driving IoU down.

categories.title: Heavily cluttered — many missed objects

categories.why_model_struggles: High instance count increases occlusion and competition between detections. The model often finds the salient objects but fails to recall smaller or partially hidden instances (high false negatives).
